title: Height Loss, Kyphosis Indicators, Bone Mineral Density and Vertebral Fractures in Chinese Postmenopausal Women
brief_summary: This is an observational and cross-sectional study on the height loss, kyphosis indicators, bone mineral density and vertebral fractures in Chinese postmenopausal women
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Postmenopausal women aged ≥50 years (Menopause was defined as the absence of menstrual cycles for at least one year)

Exclusion Criteria:

Morphological abnormalities or skeletal distortions
study_population: Postmenopausal women aged ≥50 years were randomly selected from community centers in Changsha City, Hunan Province, China in September 2017.
